description: Ferry Terminals is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by GeoBC Branch. Ferry Terminals is a point dataset identifying vehicle and passenger ferry terminals in British Columbia. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher GeoBC Branch. Its tags are ferry, ferry transportation, sites registry, terminal, transportation. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2025-07-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
